mathematics.assertion_tested: Two common-noise discretizations of the specified stochastic field equations agree in variance and match the free-X variance within five Monte Carlo standard errors.
mathematics.conventions: Four canonical real fields scaled by imposed H; complex fields are (real1+i real2)/sqrt2; drift from existing potential; noise per e-fold1/(2pi).
inputs: declared smooth FLRW scale factor; no occupied X or Phi input
non_claims: No conjugate momenta, local charge, post-inflation particle abundance or coldness.
